name: Happy Valley
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Happy Valley, OR 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Happy Valley, OR: the City Hall tree lighting with Santa, crafts, school bands, a North Pole mailbox and nearby MAX and train rides.
lede: Happy Valley gathers at City Hall each December for a tree lighting hosted by Parks and Recreation, with school bands, crafts, Santa photos and a North Pole mailbox, and the city tree is traditionally lit every evening through the New Year.
celebrates: Happy Valley Parks and Recreation hosts the annual Tree Lighting Ceremony at City Hall, 16000 SE Misty Drive, with activities indoors and outdoors. Families can try holiday crafts hosted by the Happy Valley Library and Public Art Committee, browse the Young Entrepreneurs Marketplace, hear local school bands and choirs, and visit Santa for a photo. Clackamas Fire District #1 runs Operation Santa Claus, a food and toy drive, with a giving station at City Hall. Children can also drop a letter to Santa in the official North Pole mailbox inside City Hall.
lastyear: In 2025 the City of Happy Valley planned its annual Tree Lighting for Sunday, December 7, from 4 to 6 pm at City Hall. A city preview said the evening would include Youth Entrepreneur booths, so families could shop handmade gifts from local young makers before the countdown. A later city reel said City Hall was ready for the tree lighting and invited families to see the details on the city's tree lighting page.
facts: Folklore says Happy Valley got its name from local boys who sang loudly and gaily after too much hard cider at Sunnyside church services, the "happy boys from the hollow." Historical references, the city says, may point to a clever sales strategy to attract land buyers. Christian and Matilda Deardorff were the first settlers, claiming 640 acres in 1851 between Mount Scott and Scouters Mountain, and the area was once called Deardorff Valley.
trains: MAX Green Line light rail runs between Clackamas Town Center and Gateway Transit Center, close to Happy Valley, every 15 minutes or less most of the day. WES Commuter Rail, a weekday rush-hour train, serves Beaverton, Tigard, Tualatin and Wilsonville to the west. For holiday train fun, the Willamette Shore Trolley in Lake Oswego runs vintage trips toward Portland, the Oregon Rail Heritage Center runs the Holiday Express, and the Washington Park and Zoo Railway runs at the Oregon Zoo.

faq: Where is the Happy Valley tree lighting?

The City of Happy Valley holds its annual Tree Lighting Ceremony at Happy Valley City Hall, 16000 SE Misty Drive, hosted by Parks and Recreation. Activities run indoors and outdoors. The city warns that the City Hall parking lot is limited, so plan extra time and be considerate of residents when parking in nearby neighborhoods.
How can kids send a letter to Santa in Happy Valley?

Children can write a letter and drop it in the official North Pole mailbox inside City Hall, open Monday to Friday, 8 am to 5 pm. Santa plans to answer each letter, so the city asks families to follow the worksheet directions and print a clear return address.
What is Operation Santa at the Happy Valley tree lighting?

Operation Santa is an annual toy and food drive coordinated by firefighters at Clackamas Fire District #1. At the tree lighting, a giving station at City Hall accepts non-perishable food items and new, unwrapped toys to help local families in need.
Can we see the Happy Valley city tree after the event?

Yes. The city says its tree is decorated with traditional lights and can be viewed every evening through the New Year. Families who cannot make the tree lighting itself can still stop by City Hall after dark and see it lit.
Is there a train near Happy Valley for kids?

Yes. MAX Green Line light rail runs from Clackamas Town Center to Gateway Transit Center. For holiday rides, the Willamette Shore Trolley runs vintage trips from Lake Oswego toward Portland, and Portland's Oregon Rail Heritage Center runs the Holiday Express steam train each December.
